snippet.title: Project Reboot Alpha Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Back to how it was...

Join our discord and other social media!
Discord Server : https://discord.com/invite/projectreboot
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/projectrebootpw/
Twitch : https://www.twitch.tv/projectrebootpw

Project Reboot is a fan-made game created with passion and dedication by the community. It is completely free-to-play, with no in-app purchases (IAP) or any commercial intent. The project is developed solely for entertainment purposes and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or monetized in any way.

Music from this video - Pizza Tower OST - Tropical Crust (Crust Cove)
We do not own the music. Pizza tower composers are Mr. Sauceman, ClascyJitto(Frostix) and POST ELVIS.
Pizza tower belongs to Tour De Pizza.
